newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia budget forecasts on track - govt.
newsitem.headline: Australia budget forecasts on track - govt.

text.p: Australian Assistant Treasurer Rod Kemp said on Monday the government's budget projection for 1996/97 growth was looking good and fresh official data showed its forecast growth for business investment was on track.

Kemp was commenting after the release of official capital expenditure data showing a 0.9 percent rise in the September quarter. Economists said the increase gave some support to the government's August budget forecast of a 14 percent increase in business investment for the year to June 30, 1997.

"Today's figures show that that forecast is right on track and that our GDP forecast is also looking good," Kemp told parliament's upper house, the Senate. The government forecast GDP growth of 3.5 percent year-average for 1996/97.
